svg.title: Bacterial detection prevalence: DOC14, DOC28, DOC42, DOC56, HP and Gut
svg.desc: Bacterial detection prevalence in whiteleg shrimp: percentage of examined shrimp positive for each taxon. White means zero; grey means a taxon is unlisted or measurements are incomplete.

g.text: DOC14 → DOC28 → DOC42 → DOC56 / Shrimp positive (%) / 16 bacterial taxa
n = 5 shrimp per treatment and tissue at each sampling day.
Detection prevalence = positive shrimp ÷ examined shrimp × 100. Multiple taxa can occur in one shrimp.
25 percentages are unknown because measurements are incomplete. Gray also marks taxa not listed in a source.
